papers.title: Trustworthy Image Authentication using Forensic Knowledge Graphs
papers.authors: Tai D. Nguyen, Matthew C. Stamm
papers.tags: diffusion model, image classification, object detection
papers.affiliations: Drexel University
papers.intro: 本文提出取证知识图谱（FKG）框架，通过自监督特征提取、混合图注意力区域提议和迭代上下文精炼，将取证痕迹编码为结构化图，并指导视觉语言模型生成忠实、可解释的伪造检测与理由。

papers.title: The Professor: Multi-Teacher Unsupervised Prompt Distillation for Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Ahmad Algadhi, Ahmed Alzuhair, Omar Alkhulaif, Muzammil Behzad
papers.affiliations: King Fahd University of Petroleum and Minerals
papers.intro: 本文提出TheProfessor，一个多教师无监督提示蒸馏框架，通过缓存EVA-CLIP的logits与PromptSRC教师集成，在四个基准数据集上平均将谐波均值（HM）提升1.77个百分点，尤其在域偏移数据集EuroSAT上提升5.78个百分点。

papers.title: REALM: A Unified Red-Teaming Benchmark for Physical-World VLMs
papers.authors: Yifei Zhao, Qian Lou, Mengxin Zheng
papers.tags: multimodal learning, scene understanding, autonomous driving
papers.affiliations: University of Central Florida
papers.intro: 本文提出REALM，据我们所知首个面向物理世界VLM的统一红队基准，通过集成12种红队方法、3种模型无关的防御和13个VLM，并引入代理目标生成管道，在共享数据集和指标下实现公平、场景特定的对抗评估。

papers.title: E-MRL: Cross-view Aligned Evidence-driven Multimodal Reinforcement Learning for Reliable 3D Tumor Analysis
papers.authors: Sijing Li, Zhongwei Qiu, Zhuoya Wang, Boxiang Yun, Zhenyu Yi, Jianwei Xu, Wenqiao Zhang, Yingda Xia, Ling Zhang
papers.affiliations: Zhejiang University; DAMO Academy, Alibaba Group; Hupan Lab; Huazhong University of Science and Technology; East China Normal University; Shanghai Jiao Tong University
papers.intro: 提出证据驱动的多模态强化学习框架E-MRL，通过将报告生成形式化为“诊断-定位-验证”的马尔可夫决策过程，并引入跨视图一致性奖励，显著减少了3D CT肿瘤分析中的视觉幻觉，超越了传统复杂的分段辅助方法。

papers.title: Ground Then Rank: Revisiting Knowledge-Based VQA with Training-Free Entity Identification
papers.authors: Qian Ma, Qiong Wu, Zhengyi Zhou, Yao Ma
papers.affiliations: Rensselaer Polytechnic Institute, AT&T Chief Data Office
papers.intro: 本文提出一个无需训练的Identify-Before-Answer（IBA）框架，通过先利用候选实体名称让MLLM进行实体识别，再使用现成文本重排序器选择证据段落，解耦实体识别与段落重排序，在KB-VQA基准上超越需微调的多模态重排序方法，同时降低训练和推理开销。

papers.title: Machine Learning Modeling for Real-Time Melt Pool Monitoring in Laser Powder Bed Fusion Additive Manufacturing: A Hybrid Approach
papers.authors: Inioluwa Emmanuel, Zhuo Yang, Ho Yeung, Xinyao Zhang
papers.affiliations: Florida State University; National Institute of Standards and Technology
papers.intro: 本文提出了一种混合架构（EfficientNetB0特征提取 + 随机森林分类器），在1200张熔池图像数据集上实现了F1=0.9451、AUC=0.9904的分类性能，推理时间仅1.15ms，比纯深度迁移学习方法快74-156倍，为数据有限的实时LPBF质量监测提供了高效方案。

papers.title: RT-DocLayout: Real-Time End-to-End Document Layout Analysis with Reading Order in the Wild
papers.authors: Cheng Cui, Tingquan Gao, Xueqing Wang, Changda Zhou, Hongen Liu, Ting Sun, Yubo Zhang, Zelun Zhang, Jiaxuan Liu, Manhui Lin, Yue Zhang, Suyin Liang, Yiqing Xiang, Yi Liu
papers.affiliations: PaddlePaddle Team, Baidu Inc
papers.intro: RT-DocLayout 提出一个 33M 参数的端到端 Transformer 框架，基于 RT-DETR 统一完成分类、检测、像素级分割和阅读顺序预测，在多个公开基准上达到 SOTA 精度（92.46% Overall）和实时推理速度（132.1 FPS），显著提升了文档解析系统的鲁棒性和效率。

papers.title: Generative Relightable Avatars
papers.authors: Kunwar Maheep Singh, Christian Theobalt, Rishabh Dabral
papers.affiliations: Max Planck Institute for Informatics, Saarland Informatics Campus
papers.intro: 提出一种混合管道（GRA），将物理引导的显式可重照明3D化身与条件视频扩散模型相结合，在保持3D控制的同时生成具备时间一致性的高细节重照明人体视频。

papers.title: Modular Diffusion Models for Structured Visual Recognition
papers.authors: Siddhesh Khandelwal, Björn Ommer, Leonid Sigal
papers.affiliations: 未明确（整体所属机构需从作者信息推断）
papers.intro: 本文提出模块化扩散模型（MDMs），通过将联合结构化分布分解为多个条件扩散过程（每个模块独立训练），实现对异构输出空间（连续坐标、离散类别等）的有效建模，并在多个结构化视觉任务上取得优于现有扩散方法的性能。

papers.title: SATURN: Symbolic Spatial Reasoning for Multi-Perspective Grounding
papers.authors: Danial Kamali, Tanawan Premsri, Shreya Rajpal, Amir Zadeh, Chuan Li, Parisa Kordjamshidi
papers.tags: scene understanding, 3D reconstruction, pose estimation, visual grounding
papers.affiliations: Michigan State University, Lambda Labs
papers.intro: SATURN提出一个神经符号框架，通过重建近似3D场景、推导软视角感知空间谓词，并利用无训练的Python符号执行组合多跳推理，实现稳定、鲁棒的视角感知组合空间推理。

papers.title: Prompting Diffusion Models for Zero-Shot Instance Segmentation
papers.authors: Irem Zeynep Alagöz, Nils Morbitzer, Andrea Ramazzina, Nassir Navab, Federico Tombari, Stefano Gasperini
papers.affiliations: Technical University of Munich (TUM), Munich Center of Machine Learning (MCML), Mercedes-Benz AG, Visualais
papers.intro: 本文提出Prompt2Seg，通过ControlNet将空间提示（如2D高斯图或置信度图）显式注入冻结的扩散分割模型，首次实现基于扩散模型的交互式实例分割，并在多种零样本场景下超越现有方法。

papers.title: Learning Entropy Signature for Image Representation and Classification
papers.authors: Jan Glaser, Ivo Bukovsky, Noriyasu Homma, Marcel Jirina
papers.affiliations: Czech Technical University in Prague, University of South Bohemia in Ceske Budejovice, Tohoku University Graduate School of Medicine
papers.intro: 本文提出Learning Entropy Signature (LES)，通过从Spatial Learning Entropy Map (SLEM)中选取K个最大学习熵位置及其空间排列信息，构建紧凑的图像描述符，并通过t-SNE投影验证其在合成形状、手写数字和人脸图像上的类别区分能力。

papers.title: 4DVLT: Dynamic Scene Understanding with Worldline-Centered Vision-Language Tracking
papers.authors: Chaoyue Li, Boxue Yang, Shengyao Zhou, Haoyang Wu, Rui Qian, Linfeng Zhang
papers.affiliations: Huazhong University of Science and Technology (Chaoyue Li, Haoyang Wu); Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Boxue Yang, Rui Qian, Linfeng Zhang); Zhejiang University (Shengyao Zhou)
papers.intro: 本文提出4DVLT（以世界线为中心的视觉语言跟踪任务）及大规模基准Instruct-4D，并开发4DTrack框架，将指令条件跟踪转化为图条件世界线推理，显著超越现有VLT基线。

papers.title: OmniSpace: Efficient Geometry Awareness for Autonomous Vehicles MLLMs
papers.authors: Hao Vo, Phu Loc Nguyen, Khoa Vo, Sieu Tran, Duc Minh Nguyen, Ngo Xuan Cuong, Nghi D. Q. Bui, Anh Nguyen, Duy Minh Ho Nguyen, Ngan Le
papers.affiliations: University of Arkansas, USA; Google Research, Google; University of Liverpool, UK; Max Planck Research School for Intelligent Systems
papers.intro: 本文提出OmniSpace，一种简单有效的即插即用范式，通过相机位姿注入、多视图极线注意力和3D几何蒸馏，在不引入额外测试时3D模型的情况下，使MLLMs从纯2D观测中实现几何感知空间推理。

papers.title: Automated sign detection across the Electronic Babylonian Library: A large-scale dataset and end-to-end cuneiform OCR pipeline
papers.authors: Wentao Che, Esteban Garcés Arias, Asim Niaz, Andreas Bender, Enrique Jiménez
papers.affiliations: LMU Munich (Institute of Assyriology and Hittite Studies, Department of Statistics), Munich Center for Machine Learning (MCML)
papers.intro: 本文基于Deformable DETR构建了端到端楔形文字OCR流水线，利用最大标注数据集（124,504个符号）进行训练，并在eBL语料库的87,668个碎片上进行大规模推理，实现了比先前工作提升28-37%的检测性能。

papers.title: Sol Video Inference Engine: Agent-Native Full-Stack Acceleration Framework for Efficient Video Generation
papers.authors: Yitong Li, Junsong Chen, Haopeng Li, Haozhe Liu, Jincheng Yu, Ligeng Zhu, Ping Luo, Song Han, Enze Xie
papers.affiliations: NVIDIA Research, Efficient AI Team & Singapore Lab
papers.intro: 提出基于智能体的、无需训练的全栈加速框架Sol Video Inference Engine，将缓存、稀疏注意力、令牌剪枝、量化和内核融合五种技术组织成智能体工作流，针对具体部署实例自动进行局部优化与全局组合，在三种大规模视频扩散模型上实现2倍以上端到端加速且质量近乎无损。

papers.title: MapReason-OSM: Can Vision-Language Models Make Graph-Verifiable Mobility Decisions from Street Maps ?
papers.authors: Srinivas Venkatanarayanan, Clement Pakkam Isaac
papers.affiliations: NVIDIA, University of Central Florida, University of South Florida
papers.intro: 本文提出 MapReason-OSM，一个基于自渲染OpenStreetMap面板和隐藏街道图的图可验证移动决策基准，通过精确符号评分链揭示VLMs在感知与推理间的显著差距，尤其是在图成本推理（如设施位置选择）上接近随机，且决策常缩放不一致。

papers.title: CapRiCorn-1K: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Video Captioning and Subject Referential Consistency Across Temporal Scales
papers.authors: Xinlong Chen, Jiafu Tang, Yue Ding, Yizhuo Jia, Bozhou Li, Bohan Zeng, Yang Shi, Shihao Li, Yiyan Ji, Qiang Liu, Weihong Lin, Yuanxing Zhang, Pengfei Wan, Liang Wang, Tieniu Tan
papers.affiliations: 多机构合作，详见"十二、作者机构"部分
papers.intro: CapRiCorn-1K是首个同时评估长视频描述质量与主体引用一致性的综合基准，包含1,000段时长跨15秒至600秒、含动态场景转换的多样化视频，并提出基于关键点的Acc/Cov/Ref指标体系和双模态（视听/纯视觉）评估协议，系统揭示了现有描述模型在长时视频上的性能退化与下游任务相关性。

papers.title: HPP: Hierarchical Programmatic Probing for Long Video Understanding by Decoupling Perception and Reasoning
papers.authors: Awais Rauf, Ahmed Hasssan, Greg Slabaugh
papers.tags: multimodal learning, video segmentation, video search, scene understanding
papers.affiliations: Queen's University Belfast; AMD; Queen Mary University of London
papers.intro: 本文提出HPP框架，通过将长视频理解重构为对分层分割视频的迭代程序化探测，将语义感知与高阶时序推理解耦，使具备编码能力的LLM在交互式编码环境中规划并执行多步策略，按需调用轻量级VLM进行局部感知，从而显著提升长视频理解性能。

papers.title: T-MOR: Learning Motion-Aware Skeleton Representations for Human Action Recognition
papers.authors: Di Yang, Mahmoud Ali, Quan Kong, Gianpiero Francesca, Francois Bremond
papers.affiliations: Suzhou Institute for Advanced Research, University of Science and Technology of China; Inria Center at Université Côte d’Azur; Woven by Toyota; Toyota Motor Europe
papers.intro: T-MOR提出一种通过聚类引导的多模态对比学习，将骨架运动表示与视频和文本语义对齐的框架，训练后仅用轻量骨架输入即可进行动作识别，并实现强大的零样本与少样本迁移能力。
